arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'CA'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose merchant location is in California, across the full data range.
assumptions: California is identified by the two-letter state code 'CA' in merchant_locations.state.
The count covers all transactions in the data, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, labelled or not.
Transactions are matched to locations via merchant_location_id, not merchant_id.
